description: Open-source Poly-phase Distribution System Power Flow Analysis Tool (DxFlow) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Dr. Hemanth Kumar Vemprala, Mohammad Asif Iqbal Khan. "This folder contains comprehensive documentation on the DxFlow tool, including its architecture, mathematical foundations, and practical use cases. DxFlow is an open-source distribution system power flow analysis tool developed in the MATLAB environment.The first release of DxFlow supports both single-phase and multi-phase power flow analysis using the standard Forward-Backward Sweep (FBS) method. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
